question: For the 5,964 census first-ray growers CENSUS-FORGET left undecided (non-forgetting or capped non-chains), is the least bond to any covered copy at depth s, members anywhere, bounded per depth or growing?

definitions.lemmas: research/CARRY-BOUND-20261114-001/preregistration.md (Lemma W, Theorem B, widened B, Lemma G, Lemma G2; addendum c75547967)

public_inputs.code: Codex's codex/ (window, brute, gates, sample, summarize, jobs); CENSUS-FORGET results; TIE-CYCLE ties.py; EVERY-RAY paths_dp; FREE-TARGET referee direct_bonds

forbidden_inputs: Population window, path or direct results before the freeze
cheapest_meaningful_control: negative control on 300 forgetting families; brute force on 50

predictions.P2: O bounded share >=20 points below I
predictions.P3: >=80% of I residual without knot-meeting carried positions

stop_rule: One census-wide window run, the path DP and direct search on the frozen sample; referee hand-off; report.
